field.purposeDetail: What is the purpose of your trip?

hint.fullName: Exactly as printed in the machine-readable zone of your passport.
hint.guardian: The person responsible for this applicant.
hint.passportNo: Letters and numbers only, with no spaces.
hint.expiryDate: Must be valid for at least 6 months after you leave.
hint.phone: We send one-time codes to this number.
hint.purposeDetail: One or two sentences is enough.
hint.inviterPhone: Used only to confirm your invitation.

why.fullName: Border officers compare your application against your passport, so the name must match exactly.
why.fullNameAr: Some authorities match records by Arabic name, so a name in Arabic can speed up checks.
why.nationality: Eligibility and fees depend on your nationality, which is set by your passport — not where you live.
why.passportNo: This identifies your travel document to the authority.
why.passportExpiry: Many countries refuse entry on a passport that expires soon after your trip. Six months is the usual rule.
why.email: Decisions and requests go here, so it must be an address you actually read.
why.phone: If we need to clarify something, SMS reaches you faster than email.
why.guardian: Applicants under 18 need a guardian to confirm the application.
why.accommodation: We check that you have somewhere to stay for your whole visit.
why.inviterPhone: We contact your host to confirm the invitation is genuine.
